title: Lagged or inverted piles.
officialText:
The use of lagged or inverted piles is permitted. Double lagging shall be adequately
connected to the basic pile material to transfer the full pile load from the basic pile material to the lagging without exceeding
values of allowable stress as established in Chapter 23. The connection for single lagging shall be proportioned for half the pile
load. The diameter of any inverted pile at any section shall be adequate to resist the applied load without exceeding the stresses
specified in Section 1809.5.4, but in no case shall it be less than 8 inches (203 mm).
